items.title: United Airlines (UAL) Maps Its Biggest Ever International Buildout Across 10 New Cities
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings (NasdaqGS:UAL) has announced the largest international network expansion in its history, planning 10 new international cities and several exclusive nonstop routes for 2027. The airline expects to be the only U.S. carrier serving eight of the newly announced international cities once the routes begin operating. items.title: Why a Single Wire Report About Government Cash Sent AMD, Intel, and Micron Higher Overnight
items.summary: A single wire report about a government cash account nobody was watching sent AMD, Marvell, and Micron surging overnight, and the reason explains exactly why the same trade can unwind just as fast.

items.title: Nvidia Isn’t the Only Hero the Stock Market Needs Right Now
items.summary: Only time will tell which ends up being more exciting, but Nvidia has half a chance.  The artificial-intelligence trade, and chip stocks in particular, have faltered in recent weeks and need a timely boost from the world’s most valuable company.  Intuit  earnings have brought the sector more pain, reigniting fears over the impact of AI disruption.

items.title: United Expands Long-Haul Network With 10 International Cities Routes
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings Inc. will add destinations in Europe and Asia to its network next year, using Airbus SE's new long-range narrow-body planes. The carrier will fly the A321XLR planes from its Newark hub to locations including Luxembourg and Marseille, and from San Francisco to Okinawa, Japan. Bloomberg's Siddharth Philip joins to discus.
